Cae.description: C.A.E. block printed at the bottom of the document ("C.A.E. Nº ... Fecha Vto. CAE: ...").
Cae.title: Cae

number.description: "C.A.E. Nº": the authorization code. Digits only, without hyphens or spaces, keeping leading zeros.
number.title: Number

expiry_date.description: "Fecha Vto. CAE" as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).
expiry_date.title: Expiry Date

Customer.description:
Receptor: the customer block ("Sr.(s)", "Dirección", "IVA", "CUIT"). A Factura B to a
consumidor final may print no name, CUIT or address; those fields are then null.
Customer.title: Customer

name.description: "Sr.(s)": customer name or razón social. null when not printed on the document.
name.title: Name

cuit.description: "CUIT" in the customer block. Digits only, without hyphens or spaces, keeping leading zeros. null when not printed on the document.
cuit.title: Cuit

address.description: "Dirección" exactly as printed on that line. null when not printed on the document.
address.title: Address

vat_condition.description: Condición frente al IVA printed next to "IVA" in the customer block. Map the printed label to the value: "IVA Responsable Inscripto" -> responsable_inscripto, "IVA Sujeto Exento" -> sujeto_exento, "Consumidor Final" -> consumidor_final, "Responsable Monotributo" -> responsable_monotributo, "Sujeto No Categorizado" -> sujeto_no_categorizado, "Proveedor del Exterior" -> proveedor_del_exterior, "Cliente del Exterior" -> cliente_del_exterior, "IVA Liberado - Ley N° 19.640" -> iva_liberado_ley_19640, "Monotributista Social" -> monotributista_social, "IVA No Alcanzado" -> iva_no_alcanzado, "Monotributo Trabajador Independiente Promovido" -> monotributo_trabajador_independiente_promovido.
vat_condition.title: Vat Condition

Extracted.description: The document is a supported invoice and every mandatory field is visible.
Extracted.title: Extracted

Failed.description: No invoice can be extracted without guessing.
Failed.title: Failed

reason.description: not_an_invoice: the document is not a fiscal invoice (remito, presupuesto, any other document). unsupported_document_type: a fiscal document other than Factura A, B, C or E (Nota de Crédito, Nota de Débito, Factura M, recibo). illegible: the document cannot be read. missing_mandatory_data: a supported invoice where a mandatory value is not visible.
reason.title: Reason

detail.description: Short explanation. For missing_mandatory_data, name each missing field by its path (for example cae.number).
detail.title: Detail

Invoice.description:
An Argentine invoice (Factura A, B, C or E). Return only values that are visible on the
document; optional values that are not printed are null, and are never computed or guessed.
Invoice.title: Invoice

invoice_type.description: Invoice letter printed in the box at the top center of the document ("A", "B", "C" or "E").
invoice_type.title: Invoice Type

document_code.description: Digits of the comprobante code printed under the letter ("COD.01" -> "01"). null when not printed on the document.
document_code.title: Document Code

point_of_sale.description: Punto de venta: first part of the number printed after "Nº" ("00003-00001542" -> "00003"). Digits only, without hyphens or spaces, keeping leading zeros.
point_of_sale.title: Point Of Sale

invoice_number.description: Número de comprobante: second part of that number ("00003-00001542" -> "00001542"). Digits only, without hyphens or spaces, keeping leading zeros.
invoice_number.title: Invoice Number

issue_date.description: Issue date printed as "Fecha", as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Not "Fecha Vto. CAE" and not "Fecha de Vencimiento de Pago".
issue_date.title: Issue Date

due_date.description: "Fecha de Vencimiento de Pago" as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). null when not printed on the document.
due_date.title: Due Date

currency.description: Moneda of the invoice. "ARS" when the document shows no currency (invoices in pesos).
currency.title: Currency

exchange_rate.description: "Cotización" (tipo de cambio) of a foreign-currency invoice. null when not printed on the document. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
exchange_rate.title: Exchange Rate

items.description: Rows of the detail table, in document order. At least one.
items.title: Items

vat_breakdown.description: One entry per "IVA x%" line in the totals area, in document order. Empty when none is printed.
vat_breakdown.title: Vat Breakdown

other_taxes.description: One entry per other-tax line (tributos) in the totals area, in document order. Empty when none is printed.
other_taxes.title: Other Taxes

net_amount.description: "Neto" (importe neto gravado). null when not printed on the document. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
net_amount.title: Net Amount

non_taxed_amount.description: "No Gravado". null when not printed on the document. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
non_taxed_amount.title: Non Taxed Amount

exempt_amount.description: "Exento". null when not printed on the document. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
exempt_amount.title: Exempt Amount

vat_amount.description: Total VAT printed as a single amount. null when the document prints only per-rate "IVA x%" lines or no VAT. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
vat_amount.title: Vat Amount

total.description: "Total" (importe total). Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
total.title: Total

Issuer.description: Emisor: the business issuing the invoice, printed in the header of the document.
Issuer.title: Issuer

name.description: Razón social of the issuer as printed in the header.
name.title: Name

cuit.description: "CUIT" of the issuer, printed like "CUIT 30-71234567-1". Digits only, without hyphens or spaces, keeping leading zeros. Not the "IIBB" number, even when it has the same digits.
cuit.title: Cuit

vat_condition.description: Condición frente al IVA of the issuer, printed in the header. Map the printed label to the value: "IVA Responsable Inscripto" -> responsable_inscripto, "IVA Sujeto Exento" -> sujeto_exento, "Consumidor Final" -> consumidor_final, "Responsable Monotributo" -> responsable_monotributo, "Sujeto No Categorizado" -> sujeto_no_categorizado, "Proveedor del Exterior" -> proveedor_del_exterior, "Cliente del Exterior" -> cliente_del_exterior, "IVA Liberado - Ley N° 19.640" -> iva_liberado_ley_19640, "Monotributista Social" -> monotributista_social, "IVA No Alcanzado" -> iva_no_alcanzado, "Monotributo Trabajador Independiente Promovido" -> monotributo_trabajador_independiente_promovido.
vat_condition.title: Vat Condition

Item.description: One row of the detail table, in document order.
Item.title: Item

code.description: "Articulo" (product code) of the row. null when the row has none.
code.title: Code

description.description: "Descripción" of the row exactly as printed.
description.title: Description

quantity.description: "Cantidad" of the row. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
quantity.title: Quantity

unit_price.description: "Precio" (unit price) of the row. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
unit_price.title: Unit Price

discount.description: "Bonif." amount of the row. null when the table has no "Bonif." column. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
discount.title: Discount

vat_rate.description: VAT rate percentage from the "IVA" column ("21%" -> "21", "10,5%" -> "10.5"). The column may show the row's VAT amount glued to the rate ("21%31.500,00"); return only the rate. null when the table has no "IVA" column (Factura B and C). Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
vat_rate.title: Vat Rate

line_amount.description: "Importe" of the row as printed. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
line_amount.title: Line Amount

OtherTax.description: One other-tax line of the totals area (tributos: percepciones, impuestos internos).
OtherTax.title: OtherTax

description.description: Label of the tax line exactly as printed.
description.title: Description

amount.description: Amount printed on that line. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
amount.title: Amount

VatLine.description: One "IVA x%" line of the totals area.
VatLine.title: VatLine

rate.description: Rate from the line label ("IVA 10,5%" -> "10.5"). Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
rate.title: Rate

amount.description: Amount printed on that line. Decimal string: digits with a dot as decimal separator and no thousands separator (the document prints "338.650,00", return "338650.00").
amount.title: Amount

description: Result of extracting one document: an invoice, or an explicit failure. Never guess a value.
title: ExtractionResult

result.description: Use "extracted" only when every mandatory value is visible; otherwise "failed" with a reason.
result.title: Result
